styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating deep charcoal mood panels with diagonal light beams and clean light-grey or white infographic panels; one black pegboard scene panel
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool neutral studio lighting about 5500K; diagonal beam accents and rim light on dark panels, soft even front-left key with fill on info panels, soft contact shadows always
styleLock.surfaceSystem: brushed dark charcoal surface and black pegboard for mood scenes; matte light-grey flat surface for infographic screens; seamless white for spec screens
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; short bold headlines in #2D2D2D or white, small label text, blue accent dashes
styleLock.iconSystem: rounded rectangular solid blue labels, thin-line feature icons, numbered circular badges
styleLock.presentationRules: smoky translucent grey PP organizer with removable divider plates; stable slight 3/4 hero angle for family shots; shown closed and stacked or open with dividers
noDrift: no invented certification badges or test numbers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial storage-organizer ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #0D0D0D, paper white #FFFFFF, light grey #F2F2F0 and tech blue accent #1E7BFF; neutral-cool studio lighting with diagonal beam accents on dark panels and soft even light on info panels; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; rounded rectangular solid labels, thin-line icons and numbered circles; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with every frame composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented certification badges or test numbers.
